parsed.name: Masterflex L/S 蠕动泵
parsed.description: 一款实验室蠕动泵，通过滚轮挤压软管实现液体输送，可连续运行或按设定转数运行，常用于试剂传输、循环、灌装和一般流体处理。
parsed.description_en: A laboratory peristaltic pump that moves liquid by compressing flexible tubing. It can run continuously or for a specified number of revolutions, and is commonly used for reagent transfer, recirculation, dispensing, and general fluid handling.

actions.description: 以设定转速连续运行泵。
actions.description_en: Run the pump continuously at the specified speed.

actions.description: 按设定转数运行泵，用于定量输送液体。
actions.description_en: Run the pump for a specified number of revolutions for metered liquid transfer.

actions.description: 向泵发送底层控制指令。
actions.description_en: Send a low-level control command to the pump.

actions.description: 导出泵的当前配置或状态信息。
actions.description_en: Export the pump's current configuration or state information.

actions.description: 初始化并准备泵进行运行。
actions.description_en: Initialize and prepare the pump for operation.
